# Math Formulas

## Inline Math

The equation $E = mc^2$ is famous. Another inline formula: $\\alpha + \\beta = \\gamma$.

## Display Math

$$\int_0^\infty e^{-x^2} dx = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}$$

## Equation Environment

$$\begin{equation}
  f(x) = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{x^n}{n!}
\end{equation}$$

## Align Environment

$$\begin{align}
  a + b &= c \\
  d + e &= f
\end{align}$$
